definitions.valid_row: qc_flag==0 and yield>0 and area>0 and production>0, non-null harvest year
definitions.district_series: fnid x crop x season_name x crop_production_system; seasons/systems never averaged together
definitions.duplicated_year_in_series: if >1 source row has same fnid/crop/season/system/year, exclude that year from continuity
definitions.longest_run: maximum strictly consecutive run of distinct valid harvest years (no filled missing years)
definitions.bcu_eligible: at least 2 districts with 8+ valid years each AND >=10 harvest years containing >=2 distinct districts in same season/system, longest such stretch >=6 years
definitions.basin_eligible: at least 2 eligible BCU of distinct countries with >=8 overlapping qualifying harvest years for a common crop; based on *year*, season/system may differ between countries
definitions.geographic_assignment: previous audit's single >=80%-area-dominant BCU crosswalk, not irrigated acreage
definitions.uncertainties: qc_flag=0 only means not flagged, not a guarantee of truth; crop seasons are calendar metadata not exact phenology; nonrandom reporting gaps; historical borders; no institutional effectiveness inferred
